description: NIP-CASH on-chain withdrawal: the quote (kind 23187) and receipt (kind 23188) events, request_hash, the claim proof with q, the withdraw fee, witness addresses (segwit v0/v1+, network, script types, case), error details, quote validity, cancellation, re-mint expiry, record retention, verification costs, the Hub's quote and payout refusals in row order, cash_withdraw request refusals, payout states and replies, cancel request shapes, and cash_status' withdraw object.
source: nipcash/withdraw*.go, nipcash/reuse.go; nipcash/withdraw_test.go, withdraw_address_test.go, claim_proof_test.go, reuse_test.go (K-WQ-1..3, K-WR-1..4, K-CLAIM-5, K-WFEE-1..6, K-ADDR-1..13, K-WDET-1..3, K-WHOLD-1, K-WCAN-1..6, K-WREM-1..4, K-WRET-1..3, K-VB-2)
